questions.question: Which of the following is a strong password?
Which of the following is the safest way to keep your password secure?
content: Write it down on a sticky note and keep it on your computer
Use a password that is easy to guess, such as 'password'
Memorize your password and do not share it with anyone

questions.question: What should you do if you receive an email from an unknown sender asking for your username and password?
content: Reply back with your username and password
Ignore the email and delete it
Click on any links provided in the email

content: Clicking on random pop-up ads offering free downloads
Checking the website's reputation before downloading
Downloading files from unknown sources without checking
Providing personal information to websites for downloads

questions.question: What can be one consequence of sharing too much personal information online?
What should you do if a stranger sends you a friend request on social media?
content: Share personal information with the stranger

questions.question: Why is it important to keep your personal information private online?
content: To protect yourself from identity theft and cyberbullying

questions.question: What is hacking?
content: Unauthorized access to a computer system

questions.question: What is a digital footprint?
content: A physical footprint made on the ground
Traces of a person's online activity

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a part of your digital footprint?
content: Videos you post on the internet

questions.question: Which of the following indicates that a website is secure and can be trusted?
content: The website address does not have a padlock symbol
The website has a lot of pop-up ads
The website asks for personal information without encryption

questions.question: What does the 'https://' at the beginning of a website address indicate?
content: The website is delivering free cookies

The website is secure and encrypted

questions.question: What is a common practice that can help keep your social media account secure?
content: Clicking on links from unknown sources

questions.question: What does the lock icon next to a website's URL in the browser's address bar indicate?
content: The website is using fancy decorations
The website is secure and encrypted
